$description:
| What does this do? | Requires users to reauthenticate on a fixed interval (every 7 days) for cloud apps, using primary and secondary authentication. Excludes the break-glass account. |
| Why should you use this? | Limits how long a compromised session can remain valid if credentials or tokens are stolen. |
| What is the end-user impact? | Users are prompted to sign in again at least every seven days during normal use. |
| Learn more | [Conditional Access session lifetime](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/howto-conditional-access-session-lifetime) |
$friendlyName: Periodic reauthentication is required for all users
